toc.title: The pairs the exam likes to confuse

html:
1The pairs the exam likes to confuse

Pair The difference
Azure RBAC / Microsoft Entra roles access to Azure resources / access to directory objects
Owner / Contributor / User Access Administrator everything and access / resources, no access / access, no resources
Azure Policy / RBAC / locks what resources may look like / who may act / block delete or change
LRS / ZRS / GRS / GZRS one datacenter / zones / second region / zones + second region
SAS / stored access policy / access key limited signed URL / revoke SAS centrally / full account access
Service endpoint / private endpoint subnet identity to the public service IP / private IP in your VNet
Availability set / availability zone rack and maintenance inside a datacenter / separate datacenters
Scale up / scale out bigger instance / more instances
ACI / Container Apps / ACR quick single containers / serverless microservices with scale rules / image registry
NSG / ASG filter rules / group VMs by role for rules
Load Balancer / Application Gateway layer 4 / layer 7
Metrics / logs / Activity log numbers / records in a workspace / subscription control-plane events
Backup / Site Recovery restore a point in time / replica for regional failover

2Habits that score points

Habit Why
Narrowest scope that works Least privilege for roles, locks and policy
Built-in feature first Azure expects the managed feature (alias record, lifecycle rule, autoscale)
Constraint words "least administrative effort", "no downtime", "most secure", "lowest cost"
Read the diagram or portal Case studies hide the answer in the details
Old names Azure AD means Microsoft Entra ID
Exam tip

. Answer every question. Mark the hard ones and come back with the time left.

Exam tip

. Preview features can appear if commonly used, but most questions cover generally available features.

3Exam Q&A: final review

3.1 Practice questions (choose the best answer)

S1Users in Sales must join a group automatically. What should be used?

  • AA guest account created for each member of the Sales department
  • BA dynamic group (Entra ID P1 or higher)
  • CA resource lock on the group that prevents membership changes
  • DA budget that tracks the cost of the Sales department licenses
Show the answer

Answer: B. Dynamic groups use rules on user properties.

S2Which role lets a user manage resources but not assign access?

  • AOwner
  • BContributor
  • CReader
  • DUser Access Administrator
Show the answer

Answer: B. Contributor manages resources without assigning roles.

S3An organization must prevent resources outside two regions in every subscription. What fits?

  • AAzure Policy with Deny at a management group
  • BA resource lock on each subscription that blocks the other regions
  • CA tag named Region on every resource group in each subscription
  • DA budget with an alert when spending appears in any other region
Show the answer

Answer: A. Policy at a management group enforces region rules.

S4Data must survive the loss of one availability zone at the lowest cost. What fits?

  • ALRS
  • BGRS
  • CRA-GZRS
  • DZRS
Show the answer

Answer: D. ZRS replicates across zones.

S5A partner needs time-limited read access to a container without the account key. What fits?

  • AThe primary access key
  • BA public container
  • CThe Owner role
  • DA SAS token
Show the answer

Answer: D. A SAS gives limited, time-bound access.

S6Which feature gives a private IP address for a storage account in a VNet?

  • AA service endpoint
  • BA budget
  • CA private endpoint
  • DA tag
Show the answer

Answer: C. A private endpoint places the service on a private IP.

S7A web tier must add instances when CPU is high. What fits?

  • AA single large VM that has enough CPU for the busiest period
  • BAn availability set that spreads the VMs across fault domains
  • CA snapshot of the VM that is restored when the CPU is high
  • DA Virtual Machine Scale Set with autoscale
Show the answer

Answer: D. Scale sets autoscale on metrics.

S8A new app version must go live with no downtime and an easy rollback. What fits?

  • ADeleting and redeploying
  • BA resource lock
  • CAn App Service deployment slot swap
  • DA new subscription
Show the answer

Answer: C. Slot swaps warm up the new version and can be reversed.

S9How can a regional outage be survived with VMs replicated to another region?

  • AAzure Backup only
  • BAzure Site Recovery
  • CA tag
  • DA route table
Show the answer

Answer: B. Site Recovery replicates VMs for failover.

3.2 Recall questions

R1What is the passing score?

Show the answer

700 or greater out of 1,000.

R2What is the old name of Microsoft Entra ID?

Show the answer

Azure Active Directory.

R3Which tool shows who deleted a resource?

Show the answer

The Activity log.

R4Is VNet peering transitive?

Show the answer

No.

R5What decides NSG rule order?

Show the answer

The lowest priority number first.

R6Which feature protects VMs against datacenter failure inside a region?

Show the answer

Availability zones.

4Quick Reference Card

Topic Key fact
Exam 700 to pass, 100 minutes, proctored, interactive components possible
Domains 20-25 identities, 15-20 storage, 20-25 compute, 15-20 networking, 10-15 monitoring
Habits narrowest scope, built-in feature, read the constraint
Always answer every question
